finding: Seventeen publicly supported Air Evac programs and two LIFE FORCE / Med-Trans programs. Base identity is distinct from coordinate precision; approximate airport and temporary-facility references are explicitly qualified.

Fresh operator locator: two Georgia LIFE FORCE entries.
No permanent Georgia AirMed International base established.
Regional plan reviewed for additional programs, including Elberton discrepancy.

unplottedUnresolved.reason: Two public registrations last updated in 2018 do not establish current staffed operations. Not corroborated by current operator locator, affiliate list or public membership directory. No closure date asserted.

Regional 2024 trauma plan lists an Elberton base, but current staffed operation and launch location were not independently corroborated in operator or registry checks. Retained as unresolved rather than plotted or declared closed.

Public CMS registration was created July 22, 2026, and the county considered an Air Evac lease on August 25. Recruitment also identifies AEL 186. These establish planning activity, not a verified opening date or current launch location. No active pin is added until flight operations and the facility are corroborated.

exclusions.reason: Hospital and Metro Aviation identify Metro as aviation operator, not GMR. Distinct from legacy Augusta Med-Trans registrations.
Regional plan identifies separate operators; not attributed to GMR.

geometry.source: US Census Generalized ACS 2024, 500K county geometry
geometry.method: WGS84 geodesic rings and minimum geodesic county-edge distance.

limitations: Aerial helipad centers, public-address references and FAA estimated references are not surveyed aircraft parking positions.
Milledgeville, Douglas, Laurens County, Upson and LIFE FORCE 3 use approximate airport-facility references.
Valdosta uses a qualified temporary-facility address reference, not an asserted completed permanent hangar.
Augusta and Elberton conflicting listings and the proposed Greensboro program remain unplotted and unresolved.
Generalized county boundaries are not cadastral surveys. Adjacent-state inventories remain incomplete.
Uniform 75 NM geographic rings do not guarantee aircraft availability, response range or membership benefits.
